title: Refraction Through Media
guideExplore: Pick a medium and change incidence — watch the ray bend at the boundary.
guideWater: Water bends light toward the normal when entering from air.
guideDiamond: Diamond has a high index — rays bend sharply; TIR possible at large angles.
conditionsHint: Entering a denser medium, light bends toward the normal (Snell's law).
quizQuestion: Entering a denser medium from air, the refracted ray…
learnMore: Snell's law: n₁ sin ∠i = n₂ sin ∠r. Denser media slow light and bend it toward the normal.
